newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RTRS-Leighton to sell IPCO stake for US$28.15 million.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Leighton to sell IPCO stake for US$28.15 million.

text.p: Promet Bhd said on Tuesday it has raised its stake in IPCO International Ltd to 59.2 percent and is making a general offer at US$2.40 per share.

The company said in a statement the move followed an agreement by Promet through its subsidiary Oradea Pte Ltd to acquire a 29.6 percent stake in IPCO from Australian-based Leighton Holdings Ltd for US$28.15 million or US$2.40 per share.

Oradea will acquire 11.73 million ordinary shares of S$1.70 each, representing 29.6 percent of the existing issued and paid up capital of IPCO, for US$28.15 million, the statement said. In compliance with Singapore's code on takeovers and mergers, Promet will make a takeover offer to acquire the remaining IPCO shares it does not own.
Promet will finance the takeover offer through internal funds and bank borrowings.
According to Promet president and chief executive officer Soh Chee Wen, the acquisition will enhance the company's position as a world leader in the infrastructure sector.
